title: JS/Node tests file
description: Schema for backend/src/seeds/tests/js-avanzado.json (or node.json). Keys are question ids. Each value is an array of test entries for executeJavaScript (QuickJS sandbox).

input.description: Array of args passed to the user's function, OR a single value passed directly. JS sandbox wraps userCode, calls fn(...input), JSON.stringify the result, compares to expected.

expected.description: Expected JSON-serialized return value from the user's function.
